claims.text: Mild oropharyngeal candidiasis: clotrimazole troches 10 mg 5 times daily for 7–14 days (recommended).
claims.quote: For mild disease, clotrimazole troches, 10 mg 5 times daily, OR miconazole mucoadhesive buccal 50-mg tablet applied to the mucosal surface over the canine fossa once daily for 7–14 days are recommended

claims.text: Alternative: nystatin suspension (100 000 U/mL) 4–6 mL 4 times daily for 7–14 days.
claims.quote: Alternatives for mild disease include nystatin suspension (100 000 U/mL) 4–6 mL 4 times daily, OR 1–2 nystatin pastilles (200 000 U each) 4 times daily, for 7–14 days
